scope: H67/Motion ep35 threshold-carry and late-scale evidence chain from M32 through M496

decision.reason: The high-work binary selected-weight mechanism has already moved into C1/M473 and C2/FC2. M35 already implements exact raw Q24 late scale. The remaining epsilon/RNE/current-batch-BN composition is real but may be descriptor-only, while ideal system sensitivity from removing all ten M35 scale cycles is only 1.00617x.

absorbed_or_reframed: C1/M473 absorbs the four-Conv binary/product integer boundary but not scale/RNE/BN
M231 proves the separate 12-FFN FC2 input thresholds are exact one for H67 ep35
M35 provides a general exact ten-descriptor raw-Q24 scale fallback
open: seven-consumer current-batch BN epsilon and finite-RNE order
downsample and two FC1 accumulator traces
complete numeric-boundary matched area and energy

numeric_facts.real_domain_identity: BN(theta*A; eps) = BN(A; eps/theta^2) for theta>0 with correspondingly scaled current-batch moments
numeric_facts.warning: Observed +/-1 exceptions do not prove a general +/-1 hardware range.

offline_miter_hard_gates: Pin H67 ep35 checkpoint, DSEC S10 manifest, no_running BN policy and all ten M32 state_dict keys
Freeze every fixed-point stage: width, binary point, signedness, RNE tie-even, saturation, bias and residual order
Zero mismatch for seven BN-followed consumers at scale, moments, affine, ATLIF and residual commit boundaries
Zero mismatch for all three prediction heads with exact static-scale/bias order
Add analytic overflow proofs and rail/mutation tests including theta=1, half ties, variance near zero and saturation
Treat identical quantized epsilon descriptor plus zero mismatches as descriptor absorption, not new RTL
